subject: MedLogix — next step: ML/infra immersion (60–90 min) / proposed agenda
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Carlos Ramirez <carlos@medlogix.com>, Ava Pereira <ava.p@medlogix.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2027 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: MedLogix — next step: ML/infra immersion (60–90 min) / proposed agenda

Hi Carlos / Ava —

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to hear more about the real-time inference needs for your clinical routing product and the throughput/latency targets you mentioned (target: 50 req/s p95 < 300ms). Quick recap and proposal for next steps so we can bring the ML/infra folks into the room: 

Recap (from our discovery):
- Main constraint: inference latency for short prompts + batch processing during peak windows (evening care hours).
- Data gravity: customer PHI will be proxied through MedLogix VPC; encryption at rest required.
- Current stack: model hosted on private infra, looking for migration options and cost improvements.

Proposed next step: 60–90 minute technical immersion with your ML/infra and SRE teams — goal is to validate architecture assumptions, run through preflight checklist, and agree on an initial pilot plan (metrics, pinning model version, rollout policy). Suggested agenda below.

Proposed 75-minute agenda (we can trim to 60 or extend to 90):
1) 10m — Introductions & success criteria (you + Redwood)
2) 15m — Current infra & traffic profile (MedLogix to present)
3) 20m — Redwood runtime & recommended deployment patterns (we’ll demo batch/caching behavior)
4) 20m — Integration checklist (VPC, KMS, audit logs, data flow) + Q&A
5) 10m — Next steps & pilot kickoff items (owner, timeline, docs needed)

What we need from you ahead of the session (if possible):
- Sample request/response payloads (anonymized) and average sequence lengths
- Peak concurrency estimates and expected p95 latency targets
- A contact from SRE who can confirm networking/KMS setup (Heather? Ben?)

I’ve attached a first-draft agenda and our preflight checklist to make scheduling smoother.

Availability — we can do the immersion next week or the week after. Proposed windows (PST):
- Wed 11/10: 9:00–12:00 or 14:00–16:30
- Thu 11/11: 11:00–15:00
- Mon 11/15: 08:30–11:30

If you share a couple of preferred slots I’ll coordinate internal attendees (Jasmine will lead the technical portion; Marcus will own the calendar/invite).

Thanks — looking forward to locking something in.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: MedLogix-Proposed-Agenda-v1.pdf (1 page), Redwood-Preflight-Checklist.docx (7 pages)

From: Carlos Ramirez <carlos@medlogix.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ava Pereira <ava.p@medlogix.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2027 12:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MedLogix — next step: ML/infra immersion (60–90 min) / proposed agenda

Stephanie —

Thanks for the clear recap and agenda. This looks right to us. A few quick notes:
- Heather Cho (cc: heather.cho@medlogix.com) is our SRE lead and will need to be part of the immersion; she handles KMS and peering.
- Ben (our CTO) asked that we include a short segment on audit logging and retention policy (can be part of the integration checklist).

Availability (EST) that maps to your PST windows — we prefer mornings our side:
- Thu 11/11: 11:00–12:30 EST (maps to 08:00–09:30 PST) — tight but doable
- Mon 11/15: 09:30–11:00 EST (maps to 06:30–08:00 PST) — earlier than your proposed times but we can flex
- Tue 11/16: 13:00–15:00 EST (maps to 10:00–12:00 PST) — this is our top choice

Two asks before the call: 1) can you confirm roughly which Redwood engineers will attend (names/roles), and 2) do you have a short checklist of documents Heather should prepare? She’ll want SOC2 evidence and any required network peering detail up front.

If Tuesday 11/16 10:00–11:30 PST works for your team we can lock it. Also plan to include Heather and Ben for the first 45 minutes; the rest can be a narrower engineering discussion.

Thanks,
Carlos
Head of Product Operations | MedLogix
carlos@medlogix.com | +1 (617) 555-0123

--
Ava Pereira
Program Manager, Integrations | MedLogix

- Jasmine: can you lead the demo portion and confirm whether 75 minutes is fine vs trimming to 60? Also, which internal engineers should join (inf serv, SRE) — I propose you + Karthik (model infra) + one runtime engineer.
- Marcus: can you draft the calendar invite + Zoom and attach updated agenda v2? If Jasmine can produce a short "prep pack" (1–2 slides) listing required artifacts Heather should bring (SOC2 doc types, sample payloads, allowed IP ranges), that would be ideal.

If everyone confirms I’ll tell Carlos we’ll lock Tue 11/16 10:00–11:30 PST and include the invite.

Thanks —
Steph
